objective: Add one bounded, scenario-neutral repair attempt for semantically valid Report Designs that exceed deterministic compiler geometry while retaining original and repaired evidence and every strict validation gate.
requirements: APBRA-142 Add bounded layout repair retry for compiler-safe two-page designs
acceptance_criteria: The original AI Report Design remains immutable evidence and any repaired design is separately traceable.
At most one layout repair attempt may use deterministic geometry findings plus the already confirmed requirement and schema; it cannot loop.
Every repaired candidate is re-normalized and must pass strict integrity, guardrails, compilation and deterministic candidate validation.
Geometry decisions use actual x, y, width, height and 1280 by 720 bounds rather than an arbitrary visual-count threshold.
Impossible layouts, malformed measures, unknown fields, unsupported visuals and unresolved references still stop safely.
Production behavior remains scenario-neutral and introduces no ServiceNow, report, field, KPI, page or filename special cases.
verification_required: Focused layout-repair, normalization and workflow integration tests
Existing APBRA-138, APBRA-139 and APBRA-141 regressions
Full web test suite and production build
Hosted history-aware secret scan and fresh independent review
Current-head live GPT-4.1 supported happy path through deterministic candidate validation
Haseeb Power BI Desktop validation of any newly generated candidate
out_of_scope: PBIP compiler, guardrail, RAG, schema-ingestion, PDF, styling, dependency, backend, environment or security-model changes
Deleting required business content, inventing business semantics or repairing malformed measure contracts
Scenario-specific ServiceNow, report-name, filename, field, KPI or page logic
Weakening strict visual, measure, citation, compiler, geometry or deterministic validation controls
Production deployment or claiming Power BI Desktop success without Haseeb confirmation
escalate_when: A required path is outside the exact allowlist
A layout cannot be repaired without changing confirmed business semantics
Accepted sources conflict or an APBRA-138, APBRA-139 or APBRA-141 invariant would need weakening
Live Foundry, build, bootstrap, secret scanning or independent review is unavailable
actual_authenticated_actor: Codex governance execution via haseebulhaque authenticated GitHub connection
dependencies: APBRA-141 implementation PR #27 must merge before APBRA-142 implementation begins.
Merged APBRA-138 integrity and APBRA-139 normalization controls remain authoritative.
This APBRA-142 governance registration must merge before the separate implementation begins.
